svg.aria-label: Animated: 30 sandboxes requested at once. Without lookahead most turn red and the typical wait is about 24 seconds. With Claude Code or Codex sending a heads-up through lookahead, all 30 are green within a second.
svg.text: An agent needs 30 sandboxes at once. How long does it wait?
Each square is one sandbox. Replayed from real runs, 5× faster.
